Trump Says ‘Well, You Should’ve Had Stock’ After Being Asked About $3 Billion Jump in His Net Worth: ‘I Have a Lotta Money’

During a CBS "60 Minutes" interview, Douthat asked Trump about a Forbes estimate that his net worth had increased by roughly $3 billion since returning to the White House. Trump said he could not say whether his fortune had risen and responded, "Well, you should’ve had stock," adding that he was not the only person becoming wealthier.
